senses.gloss:
m. (-गः)
1 The betelnut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
2 A heap, a quantity, a multitude.
3 Disposition, property, nature.
4 The Jack tree.
n. (-गं)
The fruit of the faufel, the betelnut.
E.
पू to cleanse, गन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Assembled, collected.
E.
पूग, and कृत made.

n. (-त्रं)
A betel-box.
E.
पूग, and पात्र a vessel.

n. (-ठं)
A spitting pot.
E.
पूग betel, and पीठ a stool; chewing the pān producing an increased excretion of saliva.

f. (-का)
Flowers and betel presented to the principal guests at a marriage festival.
E.
पूग, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.

n. (-लं)
The Areca nut.
E.
पूग, and फल fruit.

m. (-टः)
The marshy date tree, (Phoenix or Elate paludosa.)
E.
पूग Areca, and रुट् to shine, to resemble, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added पूगरोटक.
